en: A monochrome/sepia postcard view of a dramatic granite valley landscape with domed rock formations and forested slopes. A meadow with trees is in the foreground, steep rock walls and domes rise in the background, and clouds fill the sky. Red and black handwritten catalog numbers appear near the top, and printed red text in the upper right identifies the location as Yosemite in California.
